notes.text: Dimi son of Rav Huna of Damhorya poses a question to Ravina.
The text again names the son of Rav Huna, spelling the place Damharya in this witness.

The alternative parentage and Nehardea notice remain in the English as reported. The two exact Bavli loci have Huna and Damharya. Compare Menachot 81a and Sanhedrin 29b and the source-local variant note.
